items.title: [@microsoft/aspire-cli] Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-120792 - Aspire Information Disclosure Vulnerability
items.summary: Executive summaryMicrosoft is releasing this security advisory to provide information about a vulnerability in the Aspire CLI. This advisory provides guidance on updating affected applications and components.Insecure temporary files used by Aspire CLI can allow a local attacker to obtain sensitive configuration information.AnnouncementAnnouncement for this issue can be found at https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/518CVSS DetailsVersion: 3.1Severity: HighScore: 7.3Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:LWeakness: CWE-532 (Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File)MSRC severity: ImportantImpact: Information DisclosureAffected PlatformsPlatforms: Linux, macOSArchitectures: x64, Arm64Affected PackagesStandalone Aspire CLIPackageAffected versionPatched versionAspire CLI (Aspire.Cli)>= 13.2.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire.Cli.linux-x64>= 13.3.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire.Cli.linux-arm64>= 13.3.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire.Cli.linux-musl-x64>= 13.3.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire.Cli.osx-x64>= 13.3.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire.Cli.osx-arm64>= 13.3.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire CLI npm packagesPackageAffected versionPatched version@microsoft/aspire-cli>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5@microsoft/aspire-cli-linux-x64>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5@microsoft/aspire-cli-linux-arm64>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5@microsoft/aspire-cli-linux-musl-x64>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5@microsoft/aspire-cli-osx-x64>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5@microsoft/aspire-cli-osx-arm64>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5The affected component is the Aspire CLI's deprecated MCP configuration scanner, which ships in the CLI packages listed above. Its temporary-file diagnostics can include configuration content and use a fixed path in a shared temporary directory.Advisory FAQHow do I know if I am affected?The reported scenario involves running Aspire CLI agent or MCP initialization commands on a non-Windows system with a temporary directory shared by multiple users. Versions 13.2.0 through 13.6.4 are affected.Aspire ships independently of .NET. Installing a .NET runtime or SDK update does not establish that the affected Aspire CLI has been updated.How do I fix the issue?Update the Aspire CLI to version 13.6.5 or later. If installed as a .NET tool, update the Aspire.Cli package. If installed using npm, update @microsoft/aspire-cli to version 13.6.5 or later; its platform-specific dependency must also resolve to version 13.6.5 or later. Otherwise update the CLI through its installation method.Other InformationReporting Security IssuesIf you have found a potential security issue in a supported version of .NET, please report it to the Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) via the MSRC Researcher Portal. Further information can be found in the MSRC Report an Issue FAQ.Security reports made through MSRC may qualify for the Microsoft .NET Bounty. Details of the Microsoft .NET Bounty Program including terms and conditions are at https://aka.ms/corebounty.SupportYou can ask questions about this issue in the Aspire repository.DisclaimerThe information provided in this advisory is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. Microsoft disclaims all warranties, either express or implied, including the warranties of merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose. In no event shall Microsoft Corporation or its suppliers be liable for any damages whatsoever including direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, loss of business profits or special damages, even if Microsoft Corporation or its suppliers have been advised of the possibility of such damages. Some states do not allow the exclusion or limitation of liability for consequential or incidental damages so the foregoing limitation may not apply.External LinksCVE-2026-120792Acknowledgementsl8BL with ENKI WhiteHat71C4RevisionsV1.0 (November 10, 2026): Advisory published.Referenceshttps://github.com/microsoft/aspire/security/advisories/GHSA-q6jf-24jf-m3cghttps://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-120792https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/518https://github.com/microsoft/aspire/issues/22100https://github.com/microsoft/aspire/pull/22071https://github.com/microsoft/aspire/commit/c408ec5bf44e43203c278990a43aea93145248f3https://github.com/microsoft/aspire/releases/tag/v13.6.5https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-120792https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q6jf-24jf-m3cg

items.title: [@microsoft/aspire-cli] Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-120778 - Aspire Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
items.summary: Executive summaryMicrosoft is releasing this security advisory to provide information about a vulnerability in the Aspire CLI. This advisory provides guidance on updating affected applications and components.An insecure temporary directory used by Aspire CLI-generated builds can allow a local attacker to influence MSBuild response-file discovery and execute code with the privileges of the developer running the CLI.AnnouncementAnnouncement for this issue can be found at https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/519CVSS DetailsVersion: 3.1Severity: HighScore: 7.3Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:HWeakness: CWE-379 (Creation of Temporary File in Directory with Insecure Permissions)MSRC severity: ImportantAffected PlatformsPlatforms: Linux, macOSArchitectures: x64, Arm64Affected PackagesStandalone Aspire CLIPackageAffected versionPatched versionAspire.Cli>= 13.2.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire.Cli.linux-x64>= 13.3.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire.Cli.linux-arm64>= 13.3.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire.Cli.linux-musl-x64>= 13.3.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire.Cli.osx-x64>= 13.3.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire.Cli.osx-arm64>= 13.3.0, < 13.6.513.6.5Aspire CLI npm packagesPackageAffected versionPatched version@microsoft/aspire-cli>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5@microsoft/aspire-cli-linux-x64>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5@microsoft/aspire-cli-linux-arm64>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5@microsoft/aspire-cli-linux-musl-x64>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5@microsoft/aspire-cli-osx-x64>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5@microsoft/aspire-cli-osx-arm64>= 13.4.2, < 13.6.513.6.5The affected scenario concerns CLI-generated server and integration builds on non-Windows systems when a local attacker can influence automatic MSBuild response-file discovery through an attacker-writable directory. This includes builds started by aspire sdk generate, aspire sdk dump, and aspire sdk export.Advisory FAQHow do I know if I am affected?The reported scenario involves a local attacker influencing a generated build through a shared temporary-directory ancestor while another user invokes the Aspire CLI. Versions 13.2.0 through 13.6.4 are affected.Aspire ships independently of .NET. Installing a .NET runtime or SDK update does not establish that the affected Aspire CLI has been updated.How do I fix the issue?Update the Aspire CLI to version 13.6.5 or later. If installed as a .NET tool, update the Aspire.Cli package. If installed using npm, update @microsoft/aspire-cli to version 13.6.5 or later; its platform-specific dependency must also resolve to version 13.6.5 or later. Otherwise update the CLI through its installation method.Other InformationReporting Security IssuesIf you have found a potential security issue in a supported version of .NET, please report it to the Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) via the MSRC Researcher Portal. Further information can be found in the MSRC Report an Issue FAQ.Security reports made through MSRC may qualify for the Microsoft .NET Bounty. Details of the Microsoft .NET Bounty Program including terms and conditions are at https://aka.ms/corebounty.SupportYou can ask questions about this issue in the Aspire repository.DisclaimerThe information provided in this advisory is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. In no event shall Microsoft Corporation or its suppliers be liable for any damages whatsoever including direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, loss of business profits or special damages, even if Microsoft Corporation or its suppliers have been advised of the possibility of such damages. Some states do not allow the exclusion or limitation of liability for consequential or incidental damages so the foregoing limitation may not apply.External LinksCVE-2026-120778Acknowledgementsl8BL with ENKI WhiteHatRevisionsV1.0 (November 10, 2026): Advisory published.Referenceshttps://github.com/microsoft/aspire/security/advisories/GHSA-m63f-xhvm-6mv5https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-120778https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/519https://github.com/microsoft/aspire/issues/22101https://github.com/microsoft/aspire/pull/22071https://github.com/microsoft/aspire/commit/1ecd7cc70b5a5a5b8571fe3af69faa1646b8de47https://github.com/microsoft/aspire/releases/tag/v13.6.5https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-120778https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-m63f-xhvm-6mv5

items.title: [react-server-dom-turbopack] React: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in React Server Components
items.summary: ImpactCrafted payloads targeting frameworks supporting React Server Components can lead to remote code execution. This only affects extremely rare cases where responses transport multiple typed arrays and an attacker-controlled value.Updating immediately is recommended.The vulnerability exists in versions 19.0.0 through 19.0.8, 19.1.0 through 19.1.9, 19.2.0 through 19.2.8 and 19.3.0 of:react-server-dom-webpackreact-server-dom-parcelreact-server-dom-turbopackPatchesFixes were back ported to versions 19.0.09, 19.1.10, 19.2.9, and 19.3.1.If applications are using any of the above packages please upgrade to any of the fixed versions immediately.If an app’s React code does not use a server, the app is not affected by this vulnerability. If an app does not use a framework, bundler, or bundler plugin that supports React Server Components, the app is not affected by this vulnerability.Referenceshttps://github.com/react/react/security/advisories/GHSA-xqc2-xf4c-x3h3https://github.com/react/react/pull/37842https://github.com/react/react/pull/37843https://github.com/react/react/pull/37844https://github.com/react/react/pull/37845https://github.com/react/react/pull/37846https://github.com/react/react/commit/0c9913ae87283f96e868a8f1c20a3389827632d0https://github.com/react/react/commit/249ac87b0dadea4ba024d1393e5cb60cf1186080https://github.com/react/react/commit/3d06b4005ac0cf9dec37267f26174adfe6d83611https://github.com/react/react/commit/611d9217df39cf7b8ac91b2e41fd00555923e904https://github.com/react/react/commit/61aa00df822d0eb76d0362eb8b6fdd3527693efehttps://github.com/react/react/releases/tag/v19.0.9https://github.com/react/react/releases/tag/v19.1.10https://github.com/react/react/releases/tag/v19.2.9https://github.com/react/react/releases/tag/v19.3.1https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xqc2-xf4c-x3h3
